subject: SIG v21 variant migration & provenance plan
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@cloudtrust.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG v21: request for migration plan, re-answers, and provenance

Hi Irene,

CloudTrust is reviewing the incoming SIG v21 release notes and we noticed several question renames and a handful of schema splits that will affect previously exchanged answers. For our audit team we need: a) a canonical diff listing question-level changes, b) the set of re-answers that map to the new schema, and c) provenance for each re-answer (who edited it, when, and the evidence file id).

Can Redwood provide a migration plan and approximate ETA? We will need those artifacts for our downstream control mapping. If possible, please attach a diff CSV and a re-answer manifest.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior GRC Analyst
CloudTrust Inc.

--
Attachment stubs: none in this message
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v21: request for migration plan, re-answers, and provenance

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. High level plan:

- Produce a question-level diff (CSV) that tags: added / removed / renamed / split.
- Generate a re-answer spreadsheet that maps old question IDs -> new question IDs and includes the "re-answer rationale" field.
- Record provenance per re-answer (editor, timestamp, link to evidence manifest).
- Offer a short transition window where both v20 and v21 answers are available via our shared drive for 30 days.

I'm attaching a preliminary diff summary and a first pass re-answers workbook. This is a candidate migration approach; we want to get your feedback before finalizing.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0 (today): share preliminary diff + draft re-answers (attached)
- Day 2: internal review and provenance stitching (we'll add evidence ids)
- Day 5: provide finalized manifest + link to evidence bundle

If that works, I'll schedule a quick 30-minute sync with your team to walk through the splits and any ambiguous mappings.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments:
sig-v21_diff_summary.csv (CSV, 12 rows)
v21_reanswers_provenance.xlsx (Excel, 3 sheets: mappings | re-answers | provenance)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v21: request for migration plan, re-answers, and provenance

Jordan / Irene — quick technical note from the infra side: when we publish the re-answers, we'll include a per-question provenance token (UUID) and store a minimal manifest linking that token to the evidence file name and a commit timestamp. That lets your audit team verify that a re-answer was produced before a given date and which artifact substantiates it.

Questions for your team:
- Do you require an immutable evidence bundle (zip + checksum) or is a Drive link + manifest sufficient?
- For split questions, do you want the original answer preserved as an archival row or fully migrated only to the new child questions?

I'll attach a short tech note showing example provenance records.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood

--
Attachment stubs: evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 8 rows)
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@cloudtrust.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-08-03T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v21: request for migration plan, re-answers, and provenance

Thanks — that approach looks good. Our audit preference is: immutable bundle + checksum for the finalized evidence set. Drive links are fine during the draft stage, but we need the zipped bundle with SHA256 before acceptance.

On the split question policy: preserve the original answer as archival, and add explicit child answers with re-answer rationale. We'll expect the mapping file to contain both archival pointers and the new child IDs.

We can take the draft artifacts you sent and verify them internally; a quick sync tomorrow would be helpful. I'll loop in procurement only if any contractual evidence retention changes are needed.

Jordan

--
